storylines.body: October 10, AP ranks from the October 4 poll: Oklahoma 27–24 over No. 1 Texas; No. 2 Georgia 20–17 at No. 6 Alabama; No. 21 UCLA 17–15 at No. 13 Oregon; Kentucky 35–34 over No. 10 LSU in overtime; South Carolina 38–19 at No. 16 Florida; North Carolina 21–17 at No. 25 Pittsburgh. storylines.headline: Saturday changes: Rice–ECU at 1 PM ET; Kansas–Utah at 8 PM ET
storylines.body: Rice at East Carolina moved to 1 PM ET on ESPN+ because of weather. Kansas at Utah moved to 6 PM MDT / 8 PM ET, with ESPN App coverage and the linear ESPN network still to be announced. Georgia Tech says its 3:30 PM ET game remains scheduled; weather has canceled several campus festivities. Follow the schools’ current advisories before traveling.

storylines.headline: Friday finals: Louisville, Iowa, Utah State, Wyoming and BYU win
storylines.body: October 9 results: Louisville 44–20 Florida State; Iowa 41–24 Washington; Utah State 17–16 Washington State; Wyoming 16–13 San José State (OT); BYU 24–10 Iowa State. Verified October 10 against ESPN completed-game summaries, quarter scores and official school reports. The Saturday slate has 46 FBS-vs-FBS games.

storylines.headline: Thursday finals: Liberty, Western Kentucky, UTSA and South Alabama win
storylines.body: Oct 8 results: Liberty 35, Sam Houston 3 (Liberty 5–1, 2–0 CUSA); Western Kentucky 34, Missouri State 13 (Western Kentucky 2–4, 1–1 CUSA); UTSA 31, South Florida 24 (UTSA 5–1, 2–0 AAC); South Alabama 56, Arkansas State 49 (on the road; South Alabama 4–2, 2–0 Sun Belt). Earlier in Week 6: Troy 55, Southern Miss 34 (Tue); Jacksonville State 27, Kennesaw State 26 (Wed, on the road); FIU 22, New Mexico State 3 (Wed). Scores and records per ESPN game pages, verified 2026-10-09 11:07 UTC; Conference USA and Sun Belt standings pages agree. storylines.headline: North Dakota State's first FBS season is 5–0 with the nation's co-lead in scoring defense
storylines.body: The Bison (5–0), tied for the FBS lead in scoring defense at 9.8 points allowed per game (NCAA, through Oct 3), receive votes in both polls (AP 7, Coaches 29). They visit UNLV on Saturday, Oct 10 — 7 PM ET on The CW.

storylines.headline: Week 7 final: eight ranked losses and a new No. 1
storylines.body: All 59 FBS-vs-FBS finals match ESPN and NCAA. Auburn beat No. 1 Georgia 27–24; No. 8 BYU beat No. 2 Notre Dame 28–24. Twenty-two AP teams played and eight lost, using the October 11 pregame poll. Miami won 43–35 in two overtimes and leads the October 18 AP poll.

storylines.headline: No. 14 Houston at No. 10 Utah leads Week 8
storylines.body: Houston (6–1) visits Utah (6–0) Saturday at 10:15 PM ET on ESPN. Utah Athletics confirms College GameDay at President’s Circle, 9 AM–noon ET. The slate has 56 FBS-vs-FBS games, including two AP-ranked matchups: Houston–Utah and Ole Miss–Texas.

storylines.headline: UCLA: Iamaleava’s season is over
storylines.body: Coach Bob Chesney said October 19 that Nico Iamaleava will miss the rest of the season and undergo knee surgery, AP/ESPN reports. No. 9 UCLA hosts Michigan State Saturday at 3:30 PM ET on CBS. This is reported availability, not a retrieved Week 8 conference filing.
